title: Escapewheel session recipe
description: Shape of a session recipe, per Part 05 §3.1: a TOML 1.0 document, validated in its decoded form. Top-level members are closed, so a misspelled block is refused rather than dropped; a source entry and a materialization are open, because every key they do not name is an option or a parameter their adapter or materializer checks. Fact values under `session` and `subject` are untyped here: TOML dates and times decode to values JSON Schema has no type for, and a build types a fact when it normalizes it (Part 05 §3.6).

out.description: Where the packet is written, relative to the recipe.

registry.description: The core registry to write against, relative to the recipe.

extensions.description: Extension registries the packet binds, each a path or an installed registry's id.

in_process.description: Whether every source runs in the writer's process unless its entry says otherwise (Part 05 §3.9).

session.description: Session facts, keyed by field name.

subject.description: Subject facts, keyed by field name.

additionalProperties.description: Why the recipe's value supersedes the source's (Part 05 §3.6).

overrides.description: Declared facts that supersede a source's, keyed `block.field`.

encoding.description: Parquet encodings this build forces, keyed `resource.column` (Part 05 §3.8).

clock.description: The clocks the packet declares, and their parents.

kind.description: The adapter this entry reads with. A recipe lists a kind once (Part 05 §3.1).

root.description: A local directory, relative to the recipe, or a store URI.

owns.description: Resources this source alone supplies. Omitted, the build reads the entry's default (Part 05 §3.4).

contributes.description: Resources this source adds rows to alongside others.

storage_options.description: How to open a store root.

command.description: The argument list that runs the adapter; never a string to split (Part 05 §3.7).

declaration.description: The adapter's declaration document (Part 03 §11.5), relative to the recipe.

source.description: The sources the packet is built from. Every key an entry does not name here is an option, checked against its adapter's `needs` and `accepts`.
The kind of the source that owns the resource.

preference.description: Which source owns a resource more than one listed source produces, keyed by resource (Part 05 §3.3).

materialize.description: Analysis resources to derive once the core resources are staged. Every other key is a parameter.

commit.description: The build's own limits, such as `memory_budget`; their names are the implementation's.
